products.name: Neptune.ai
products.note: ML metadata store; experiment tracking; model registry; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Neptune is a software company, operating under the brand neptune.ai, that built an ML metadata store focused on experiment tracking, model registry, and training monitoring for machine learning researchers and developers. The company describes its platform as giving researchers a clear and dependable way to track experiments, monitor training, and understand complex model behavior in real time, with tools that allow users to compare thousands of runs, analyze metrics across layers, and surface issues during the training process. EU-hosted options are available among its deployment configurations.

OpenAI has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Neptune, with the stated purpose of deepening visibility into model behavior and strengthening the infrastructure that supports frontier research. According to the announcement, Neptune has worked closely with OpenAI ahead of the acquisition to develop tools specifically oriented toward large-scale model development. The site's held facts list Neptune.ai as a coding and developer tool in the ML metadata and experiment tracking category.
